zh.title: 星宇航空接收第五架A350-1000　B-58555自土魯斯啟程返台
zh.summary: 星宇航空第五架A350-1000客機B-58555於10月16日完成交付，隨後執行SJX2351交機航班，於臺北時間10月17日凌晨1時28分自土魯斯飛往桃園。
body: 星宇航空第五架Airbus A350-1000客機B-58555，於2026年10月16日在法國完成交付。航空交機追蹤平台Aviation Flights的紀錄顯示，該機隨後執行交機航班SJX2351，於台北時間10月17日凌晨1時28分，自法國土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場（TLS）起飛，前往台灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。交付日期與返台起飛日期因時差而分屬不同日。
B-58555的製造序號為805，完整機型為A350-1041，搭載兩具Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97發動機。該機先前使用測試註冊編號F-WZGM，於2026年8月27日完成首次試飛，並在交付前進行多次測試及客戶驗收飛行。
A350-1000是A350家族中的加長型廣體客機，也是星宇航空拓展長程航網的主力機型之一。星宇首架A350-1000已於2026年1月抵台；空中巴士當時公布，星宇共訂購18架同型客機，將與既有A350-900共同支援北美、歐洲及部分亞太航線。

en.title: STARLUX Takes Delivery of Fifth A350-1000 as B-58555 Departs Toulouse for Taiwan
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines' fifth A350-1000, B-58555, was delivered on October 16 and departed Toulouse for Taoyuan as delivery flight SJX2351 at 1:28 a.m. Taipei time on October 17.
body: STARLUX Airlines took delivery of its fifth Airbus A350-1000, registered B-58555, in France on October 16, 2026. Aviation Flights records show that the aircraft subsequently operated delivery flight SJX2351, departing Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) for Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) at 1:28 a.m. Taipei time on October 17. The delivery and departure dates fall on different calendar days because of the time difference.

B-58555 carries manufacturer serial number 805 and is an A350-1041 powered by two Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 engines. Previously registered F-WZGM for testing, the aircraft made its first flight on August 27, 2026, and completed further test and customer acceptance flights before delivery.

The A350-1000 is the stretched widebody variant of the A350 family and one of the key aircraft supporting STARLUX's long-haul network expansion. The airline's first A350-1000 arrived in Taiwan in January 2026. Airbus said at the time that STARLUX had ordered 18 aircraft of the type, which would join its existing A350-900s to serve North America, Europe and selected Asia-Pacific routes.
